name: QSC_PROD_GRP_ATVAL_B
description: This table stores the domain for the attributes specified in the QSC_PROD_GRP_ATTR_B table.

columns.name: PROD_GRP_ATVAL_ID
columns.description: Product Group Attribute Value Identifier

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REF_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifier used for integration with external systems.

columns.name: REVISION_NUM
columns.description: Revision Number

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Persistent Id used to reference the original version.

columns.name: ATTR_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Parent Attribute Reference Identifier. Persistent Id used to reference the original attribute version.

columns.name: CHANGE_NUM
columns.description: Column for internal use. Used internally for publishing product groups.

columns.name: PROD_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Product Group Identifier.

columns.name: ATTR_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the attribute.

columns.name: VALUE_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to FND_VS_VALUES_B.

columns.name: MIN_VALUE_NUM
columns.description: Numeric value. Minimum value in a range.

columns.name: DISPLAY_ORDER_NUM
columns.description: Manually set display order for attribute domain.

columns.name: MAX_VALUE_NUM
columns.description: Numeric value. Maximum value in a range.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency Code.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.description: Refers to the unit of measure code for numeric attributes.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
